A finish that fits your space.

We help you choose a finish based on how you want the room to look, how you use it and what the work will involve.

  1. Look and feel. Start with the style you want, from rustic stone and Mediterranean lime plaster to industrial microcement or a classic polished finish.
  2. Maintenance. Consider how often the surface will need cleaning, what products it can tolerate and whether it will need resealing.
  3. Durability and comfort. Tell us about moisture, traffic, temperature changes and any sound or insulation needs so we can assess the right system for the space.
  4. Disruption. If the room must stay in use, we’ll assess whether we can apply the finish over the existing surface and discuss preparation and curing time.
  5. Total cost. Compare materials, labour, preparation or removal, and long-term maintenance before choosing.

Why choose microcement?

  • A continuous look. Create a seamless finish across compatible surfaces while keeping required movement joints.
  • Low build-up. Some systems are about 1–3 mm thick and can be applied over sound, properly prepared substrates such as tile or concrete, reducing demolition where suitable.
  • Custom colour and texture. Hand application gives you a choice of colour, texture and sheen for walls, floors or furniture, depending on the system.
  • Performance matched to the space. Choose a system and sealer suited to traffic, moisture, outdoor exposure or slip resistance. Wet areas require a system specified for that use.
  • Simple routine care. Clean with a soft cloth or mop and a pH-neutral cleaner, following the care instructions for the system.
